audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart gives Yorick levels 2 and 3 and calls level 1 a coin flip, while the prose directly above it says the opposite: whys[0-2] and 'early' both state levels 1-3 belong to Darius.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Darius/Darius/Darius/Yorick/Yorick/Yorick/Yorick. Pre-Maiden Yorick is immobile with no ghoul economy; the flip point is when graves and Mist Walkers arrive, not level 2.
audit.corrected: Levels 1-3 flipped to Darius (7/10 each); Levels 4-5 and Level 6 flipped from 'Skill' to Yorick, matching the packet and the existing whys.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 stage was marked 'Skill' with Darius-only ultimate text (including a raw LaTeX fragment, 'R = d + a \times Stacks'), ignoring that level 6 is Yorick's spike, not Darius's, in this matchup. Later stages carry 5/10 ratings while the side says Yorick.
audit.why: Eulogy of the Isles is a 160/130/100 second ultimate that buffs Yorick's attacks against the Maiden's target — at 48.96% over 2459 games this is where Darius loses the lane, and the ratings should sit below 5/10 wherever the side is Yorick.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why rewritten around the 160s Maiden cooldown; ratings pulled to 4/10 (first item) and 3/10 (level 6, 2+ items) so the numbers agree with the sides.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two ability claims are mechanically backwards. spikes[0] and wants.you[1] say to 'E Apprehend past his W cage wall's gap' / 'E through the gap in his W cage' — Apprehend does not move Darius. spikes[3] and 'late' say 'ghouls block your E-pull and R path'.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Darius sweeps up his enemies with his axe's hook and pulls them to him' — it is a 535-range pull that sweeps every enemy caught, so Mist Walkers standing in front do not shield Yorick from it, and it never repositions Darius. Noxian Guillotine leaps to a targeted enemy champion, so a ghoul cannot body-block it either. Mourning Mist is the real tell: a 700-range projectile that marks you, after which summoned units gain move speed toward the marked target.
audit.corrected: Rewrote spikes[0], spikes[3], late, wants.you[1] and report[5] around the pull's true behaviour and the Mourning Mist mark as the ghoul-commit signal.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing in the matchup mentions Grievous Wounds, even though Last Rites heals Yorick on a 6-to-4 second cooldown and every extended trade is a healing race.
audit.why: Flagged in _missing for this exact pairing ('needs-antiheal'): Yorick sustains through chip damage via Last Rites, so anti-heal timing decides extended trades. The itemization line currently lists only Stridebreaker/Sterak's/Dead Man's.
audit.corrected: Itemization now buys Executioner's Calling early, before the second item.

audit.whatIsWrong: Last Rites is an auto-attack reset and none of the trade advice names the wind-up as the cue; also nothing states that Dark Procession is a destructible wall you can break rather than wait out.
audit.why: Flagged in _missing ('autoreset-burst-tell'): his combo opens with an auto reset, so the wind-up, not the cast, is the step-back cue. Riot's W text says 'summons a destructible wall'.
audit.corrected: Added to tldr, dosFull[0].d and dontsFull[1].d.

audit.why: Dark Procession is correctly identified as the cooldown to bait; the audit only supplied the real 20/18/16/14/12 numbers so the wait is countable.

edits.after: Dark Procession is a destructible wall — break it, don't wait it out. Kill the Mist Walkers first and end trades before Last Rites heals.

edits.before: Optimal lane control window for Darius to establish strict minion freezes. Track Dark Procession (Cage) before you commit the pull.
edits.after: His graves become Mist Walkers that soak your Decimate and add damage, and Mourning Mist marks you so they sprint straight at you.

edits.before: Noxian Guillotine deals true damage R = d + a \times Stacks, bypassing defensive items completely. The execute resets on takedowns — all-in windows are now real kill windows.
edits.after: Maiden of the Mist arrives on a 160s cooldown at rank 1 and buffs his attacks against her target; Noxian Guillotine still executes, so use it before her ghouls pile up.

edits.before: Before his Maiden is online (level 6) you have a window: at 3-5 you can E Apprehend past his W Dark Procession cage wall's gap, land outer-edge Q Decimate and W-slow to stack Hemorrhage — but once ghouls spawn from his E-marked minions the trade math turns, so all-in only when his W cage is down.
edits.after: Before Maiden (level 6) you have a window: Apprehend pulls him to you from 535 range and never moves you, so bait him forward instead of chasing him through Dark Procession. Land outer-blade Decimate, Crippling Strike for the slow, and stack Hemorrhage while his 20s wall is down.

edits.before: Full Maiden uptime and W-cage disengage make him a splitpush monster — ghouls block your E-pull and R path, he sustains through your bleed, and any extended fight feeds his ghoul stacking. Look to roam or teamfight instead of forcing the 1v1.
edits.after: Full Maiden uptime makes him a splitpush monster. Apprehend sweeps every enemy it catches, so ghouls never shield him from the pull — what beats you is Last Rites healing and stacked ghoul damage. Roam or teamfight instead of forcing the 1v1.

edits.before: With permanent Maiden uptime Yorick out-trades and out-splits you: ghouls block your E and R, he sustains through Hemorrhage, and the cage denies your engage. Farm safe and win the map, not the 1v1.
edits.after: With permanent Maiden uptime Yorick out-trades and out-splits you: Last Rites heals him every 4s at rank 5, ghoul damage out-paces your bleed, and the wall denies your engage. Win the map, not the 1v1.

edits.before: E through the gap in his W cage, then W-slow to stack Hemorrhage
edits.after: Bait him forward and Apprehend — your E pulls, it never moves you

edits.before: Traps you for ghouls. Don’t get caged. Bait it, count it, then go.
edits.after: A destructible wall, 20s at rank 1. Break it, or bait it and commit.

edits.before: Pull Yorick as he steps to last-hit, W slow, land the Q outer ring, weave two autos, and walk away at 3-4 stacks with the heal banked.
edits.after: Mourning Mist marks you from 700 range and his Mist Walkers speed up toward marked targets. Clear the ghouls first or they eat your Decimate.

edits.before: That is Yorick's favourite window — refusing it removes half his win condition.
edits.after: Maiden of the Mist is a 160s ultimate at rank 1 — refuse the fight until it ends.

edits.before: Your committal tool is the lane — burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Dark Procession is destructible and 20s at rank 1 — hit the wall, don't stand in it feeding ghouls.

edits.before: Whiffing Apprehend and then fighting anyway — without the pull you have no engage, and chasing through a wave bleeds you dry.
edits.after: Last Rites resets his auto and heals him every 4-6s, so a long fight in his mist just funds his graves and his health bar.

edits.before: Track Yorick's Dark Procession (Cage): Traps you for ghouls. Don’t get caged. Engage only while it is down.
edits.after: Mourning Mist marks you from 700, and his Mist Walkers sprint at marked targets. Dark Procession is destructible.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield + pot vs the poke. Core: Stridebreaker (the stickiness fix), then Sterak's Gage / Dead Man's Plate; boots Plated Steelcaps.
edits.after: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Last Rites heals him, so buy Executioner's Calling early; then Stridebreaker and Sterak's Gage; boots Plated Steelcaps.
